requirements.requirement: The system must include a 'relevance_score' field in each clinical trial object returned by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must preserve the numeric value of 'relevance_score' exactly as received from clinical_trials_service without modification.
The system must ensure 'relevance_score' is present for all trials when upstream service returns a valid score.
The system must return 'relevance_score' as a normalized numeric value between 0 and 1.
The system must not alter existing clinical trial response fields when adding 'relevance_score'.
The system must maintain backward-compatible response structure aside from the addition of the 'relevance_score' field.
The system must include 'relevance_score' in the same object level as other scoring attributes if such attributes exist.
The system must serialize 'relevance_score' in a JSON-compatible numeric format consumable by the chat layer.
The system must pass through multiple clinical trial records each with their own 'relevance_score' without aggregation or overwriting.
The system must ensure that absence of 'relevance_score' from upstream results in either a null field or omission, consistent across all trials.
The system must not throw an error if 'relevance_score' is missing from a trial object returned by clinical_trials_service.
The system must log a warning when 'relevance_score' is missing from any trial object in the response.
The system must expose 'relevance_score' consistently across all Evaluate Care facade endpoints that return clinical trials.
The system must ensure that downstream LLM consumers receive 'relevance_score' in a predictable and stable field name.
The system must ensure that LLM-readable responses include 'relevance_score' without requiring additional transformation by the chat layer.
The system must ensure that 'relevance_score' is not embedded within free text fields and remains a structured attribute.
The system must ensure that inclusion of 'relevance_score' does not increase response latency beyond acceptable facade thresholds.
The system must correctly propagate 'relevance_score' when multiple scoring attributes are present without conflict or overwriting.
The system must ensure that LLM outputs can reference 'relevance_score' directly for ranking or explanation purposes.
The system must return a valid response payload even if all trials have null or missing 'relevance_score' values.
